title: Understanding the Terms and Conditions
summary: When it comes to preserving your child's stem cells, it's important to have a clear understanding of the terms and conditions involved.
body_markdown:
At Anja, we believe in transparency and want to provide you with all the necessary information to make an informed decision. Our goal is that you have a comprehensive understanding of our services.


1. What are the Terms and Conditions?
They are the legal agreement that outlines the rights, responsibilities, and obligations of both parties involved in a service or product. In the case of stem cell preservation with Anja, our terms and conditions cover various aspects of the process, including consent, storage, and usage of stem cells.
2. Consent and Authorization:
Anja ensures that every parent provides explicit consent and authorization before proceeding with stem cell preservation.


‍


For detailed information or any queries regarding our terms and conditions, please view the complete document by clicking[here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/140__ob4JU3UYdtd4xkAPIA2JBWtVAwNi/edit?usp=drivesdk&ouid=113840176103879753791&rtpof=true&sd=true) . We are here to support you every step of the way on this important journey of stem cell preservation.


‍
